starter.label: Starter
starter.description: One channel (WhatsApp or website). Handles FAQs, booking/inquiry capture, and basic follow-up. Best fit: single-location small businesses (salons, clinics, small retail, single-outlet food places).

growth.label: Growth
growth.description: Multi-channel (WhatsApp + website + email). Lead capture feeding a simple CRM/sheet, monthly usage reporting. Best fit: businesses with meaningful inquiry volume, or a small handful of locations.
